project: THE STOCK MARKET: FROM THE GROUND UP
evidenceBoundaries: File and HTML route checks do not prove feature operation, entitlement, RLS or accessibility.
Each 100-case acceptance scenario requires real authenticated browser evidence under two separate test identities.
James_Test_A and James_Test_B are illustrative QA labels, not credentials or verified database accounts.
